name: Medesy implantology mallet
categoryPath: mallets > calipers and mallets > implantology
description: Implantology mallets are used in combination with chisels to elevate bone material, perform alveolar ridge separation techniques or contouring, or in combination with osteotomes for maxillary sinus elevations or preparation for implant sites. Discover the models offered by Medesy.

name: Implantology mallet
categoryPath: mallets > calipers and mallets > implantology
description: A mallet that is particularly easy to handle with an anatomical handle designed by our R&D Dept. It is used with osteotomes to prepare the alveolar bone or with chisels to elevate and/or contour bone. Teflon replacement parts available separately.

categoryPath: cranio facial instruments > implantology

name: Cranio-facial forceps
categoryPath: cranio facial instruments > implantology

name: Medoss condensing osteotome
categoryPath: osteotomes > implantology > osteotomes and sinus lift instruments
description: The Sinus Condensing model in the Medoss line of osteotomes is meticulously designed in every detail to make the site preparation procedure prior to implant placement both safe and effective. name: Implant site dilatator
categoryPath: osteotomes > implantology > osteotomes and sinus lift instruments
description: Medesy’s implant site dilatators with their conical, graduated tip are perfect for gradually preparing the implant site in the jaw. The complete line with the DALILA handle is also available in kit form.

categoryPath: tweezers and membrane instruments > implantology > tweezers implantology

name: Membrane tweezers
categoryPath: tweezers and membrane instruments > implantology > tweezers implantology

name: Micro-tweezers made of pure titanium
categoryPath: tweezers and micro tweezers > implantology > tweezers implantology
description: Perfect tweezers for use in implantology or microsurgery. Made of pure titanium, which is more biocompatible and therefore more suitable for use during invasive procedures. It is very light and has thin, delicate tips. Available in curved o straight version.

name: Medoss osteotome for sinus elevation
categoryPath: osteotomes > implantology > osteotomes and sinus lift instruments
description: The Sinus Elevation line of Medoss osteotomes feature a concave tip, and their cutting edges are designed to allow scraping and grafting of the cavity bone and transporting it to the top. The technique is less invasive with respect to the “lateral window”. Also available in a kit.

name: Bone injector
categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > instruments injectors and bone collectors > implantology
description: Stainless steel bone injectors for injecting material scraped from the oral cavity or synthetic bone. Comfortable and stable ring handle. Available in various diameters.

categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > instruments injectors and bone collectors > implantology

name: Bone scraper

At that point, the autologous bone will be immediately ready for use.

name: Bone plugger
categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > bone pluggers > implantology
description: The line of bone pluggers with its angled tips are designed for compacting scraped bone material and reaching even the most difficult areas. Medesy’s range offers models with a flat, serrated tip, cylindrical models and combo models with a bone collector.

name: Endosteal elevator

description: The tips of Medesy’s endosteal elevators for maxillary sinus elevation procedures are carefully rounded off so as to be perfectly smooth and avoid risking irreparable damage to the Schneiderian membrane. The only ones with sharp tips are the Buser instruments.

name: Bone-collecting instrument
categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > instruments injectors and bone collectors > implantology

name: Titanium mini-tray
categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > instruments injectors and bone collectors > implantology

categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > bone chisels > implantology

categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > bone chisels > implantology
description: The Ochsenbein chisel with its special tip, available in internal or external versions, is useful not only for remodelling the bone but also for elevating or removing the secondary palatal soft tissues.

name: Wakefield bone chisel
categoryPath: bone treatment instruments implantology > bone chisels > implantology

categoryPath: single use impression tray > impression trays > laboratory
description: Aluminium impression trays are much more flexible and adaptable than stainless steel models and are perfect for cases when manual correction of the form is needed to suit the patient’s anatomy. As they allow such deformations, they are considered disposable.

name: Impression tray for edentulous
categoryPath: perforated impression tray > impression trays > laboratory

name: Perforated impression tray without retention rim
categoryPath: perforated impression tray > impression trays > laboratory
description: Like their non-perforated counterparts, perforated impression trays with no mechanical retention rim, must be used with special adhesive materials that allow the impression to take correctly.

name: Perforated impression tray with retention rim
categoryPath: perforated impression tray > impression trays > laboratory

name: Non-perforated impression tray without retention rim
categoryPath: impression trays > non perforated impression tray > laboratory
description: Having no perforations and no mechanical means of retention, non-perforated impression trays with no retention rim must be used with special adhesive materials that allow the impression to take correctly. Non-perforated models are preferred when more pressure is required.

name: Non-perforated impression tray with retention rim
categoryPath: impression trays > non perforated impression tray > laboratory
description: Dental professionals assess every case individual to decide which impression tray will work best for the patient’s specific characteristics and anatomical needs. Non-perforated impression trays with retention rim are preferred when a certain amount of pressure needs to be placed on the material as the impression is being taken. The retention rim provides maximum hold.

name: Left-handed surgical scissors
categoryPath: surgery > left handed scissors > scissors
description: It is always rather uncomfortable for left-handed people to use an ordinary scissors, as it is an asymmetrical instrument. If a traditional scissors is used correctly with the right hand, the blade moving downwards is controlled by the thumb and therefore remains closer to the user’s body, following the natural tendency of the hand movement to squeeze the blades together to facilitate cutting. On the other hand, if the scissors are rotated so that they are held with the left hand, the hand would tend to force the blades outward, which would inhibit the cutting ability. In the latter case, the blade closest to the body would also move upwards covering the cutting line and making it difficult to use the instrument. For these reasons, we believe it is important to produce scissors specifically for left-handed people.

After the crown is milled, the tooth is divided into two parts: mesial and distal. The mesial part is accessible and easy to extract, while the distal part is less accessible. The special feature of this forceps is that it makes it possible to extract even those roots that are less accessible with the aid of traditional instruments; specifically, the use of elevators can cause lacerations of the adjacent soft tissues with involvement (in the most extreme cases) of the lingual nerve. These forceps offer a sure grip, preserving the adjacent tissues.

description: The Columbia model curette is designed for the removal of tartar deposits from the supragingival and subgingival surfaces of teeth. Medesy offers models for treating anterior and posterior teeth. The blades are sharpened on both sides and angled at 90°.

name: De Marco curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The De Marco curette is specifically designed for treating the anterior areas of the oral cavity; like the other universal curettes, its tips are sharpened on both sides.

name: Debridement curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The Debridement curette is specifically designed for refining the scaling work previously performed using the ultrasonic method. Made of stainless steel selected to ensure unerring performance.

name: Goldman-Fox curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The Goldman-Fox universalcurette by Medesy is available in models designed for both upper and lower teeth. It is perfect for removing subgingival tartarand cleaning roots. Both sides of the tip are meticulously sharpened.

name: Indiana University curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The Indiana University model curette is specifically designed for treating the posterior areas of the oral cavity; its tips are sharp on both sides and are angled at 90° with respect to the area to be treated. These are typical features of universal curettes.

name: Langer curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The tips of the Langer curette have double cutting edges which are angled at 90° with respect to the surface to be treated; the shanks, however, are angled in the way that is typical of Gracey curettes. The angles make it easier to access even the most difficult areas. This allows the mesial and distal surfaces to be treated with the same tip.

name: Mccall curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The McCall curette models by Medesy also include some that are designed specifically for the treatment of molars. Like the universal curettes, both tips are produced with a double cutting edge and are angled at 90°.

name: Universal curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: Both sides of the working tips of the Universal curettes are sharpened and angled at 90° with respect to the surface of the root to be treated. Made of high-quality stainless steel for efficient removal ofcalculus deposits in the subgingival and root areas.

name: Younger-Good curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The Younger-Goodcurette is perfect for removing minor deposits of supragingival and subgingival calculus from molars and premolars. As with the other universal curettes, the blades are sharp on both sides. Two handle versions available. Discover them below!

name: Kramer curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The Kramer curette, also called the perio-curette, is more rigid than universal curettes and is particularly suitable for removing large subgingival deposits.

name: Me-1 curette
categoryPath: universal curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: The ME-1 curette is perfectly effective yet gentle in the treatment of the subgingival area, which cannot be reached by scalers, as scalers would seriously damage the surrounding tissues.

name: Endodontic explorer
categoryPath: endodontics > endodontic explorers > restorative > endodontic instruments
description: The endodontic explorer or explorer probe for endodontics has a sharp tip and is used to extend the tactile sensation of the instrument and identify openings in the root canal.

name: Standard syringe
categoryPath: surgery > standard syringes > syringes surgery
description: In the very complete range of MEDESY products, we could not do without a line of classic standard syringes, which are always popular with professionals in the field. Made of chrome-plated brass, they are available with various handles and with FOLDING TYPE or REVOLVER carpule vial loading methods, a selection that aims to meet any need and cater to every dentist’s habitual practise. Compatible with 1.8-ml anaesthetic vials.

name: Stainless steel syringe
categoryPath: surgery > inox syringes > syringes surgery
description: Research aimed at increasing the quality, functionality and durability of MEDESY syringes continues with the introduction of syringes made entirely of special stainless steels that guarantee exceptional performance, strength and durability. Our new line of stainless steel syringes offers FOLDING TYPE or REVOLVER models to suit the tastes and habits of every dentist. Models in the new stainless steel range feature an innovative PATENTED helical harpoon, designed to facilitate the hooking and release of the carpule rubber seal: engages by screwing clockwise, and releases by screwing anti-clockwise. All models are available with European (EU suffix in the code) or American (AM) thread; remember to choose the correct one! Compatible with 1.8-ml anaesthetic vials.

name: Austin retractor
categoryPath: surgery > retractors > cheek and soft tissue retractors
description: The Austin cheek retractor, with its 90° bend, is perfect for retracting cheeks and tissues, thus making the oral cavity more accessible and visible during surgery. It is available in short (85 mm) or long (135 mm) versions with a hexagonal handle.

name: Hirschfield periosteal elevator
categoryPath: surgery > periosteal elevators
description: Brand new periosteal elevator from the MEDESY range, the Hirschfield model. Two rounded tips, a 3.0-mm slanted tip and a 3.5-mm straight tip, and two different shapes that are perfect for elevating periosteal tissues in different cases. The tips, which are precision-welded to the handle, are flawlessly sharpened but feature rounded edges, so to avoid injuring surrounding tissues. The handle has an ideal design for executing elevations to perfection. Total length of the instrument: 170 mm.

name: Mershon band pusher
categoryPath: auxiliary instruments and accessories > instruments for band and ligatures > orthodontics
description: Mershon band pusher with angled and serrated tip. Medesy offers it on octagonal handle easy to grip during the use.

name: Williger periosteal elevator
categoryPath: surgery > periosteal elevators
description: Single-blade WILLIGER periosteal elevator, available in two versions: rounded (7.0 mm) or pointed (6.00 mm). The entire body of the flat handle features special deep knurling, so as to maximise grip. Like all our other periosteal elevators, it is made of high-quality raw materials and finished to perfection. Total length of the instrument 155 mm.

name: Apexo elevators
categoryPath: surgery > root elevators > elevators > extraction
description: Among the new-entries in MEDESY line of root elevators we have the APEXO 301, 302 and 303 (REF 720/41 – 720/42 e 720/43) conceived specifically for extractions of very deep retained roots.

name: Mta applicator
categoryPath: mta applicators and wells > endodontics > restorative
description: MTA is a cement that is particularly biocompatible for use in new filling techniques of wide or altered root canal apexes, where use of gutta-percha is not sufficient. Medesy has recently introduced a line of applicators in line with international measurements.

name: Polished cheek and tissue retractor
categoryPath: surgery > retractors > cheek and soft tissue retractors
description: New products from MEDESY include a line of durable and effective Sternberg retractors, which are available in various sizes and made of polished stainless steel. Other models available, such as the Vestibulum and Universal cheek retractor. Discover them below!

name: Medesy - Oringer mouth gag
categoryPath: surgery > mouth gags > retractors
description: Comfortable and effective, the MEDESY-ORINGER mouth gag is ideal for holding the mouth open by supporting the cheeks for better access to distal areas.

name: Bracket positioner
categoryPath: auxiliary instruments and accessories > instruments for band and ligatures > orthodontics
description: A tool with classic lines and shape, but very efficient and functional: our bracket positioner. Spring system and polished finishes.

name: Periosteal elevator HP3
categoryPath: surgery > periosteal elevators
description: Available in two versions (with 3.3 mm – 3.3 mm or 5.2 mm and 4.8 mm blades), our HP3 periosteal elevator is made of high-quality stainless steel; one side features precision-sharpened blades, and the blades on the other side are thoroughly blunted so as to prevent unnecessary injury to tissue. It is perfectly balanced for perfect execution of periosteal tissue elevations thanks, in part, to its handle which has been specifically designed for maximum comfort and functionality. Total length of the instrument: 170 mm.

name: Single-tip explorer
categoryPath: single tip explorers > diagnostics > explorers
description: Extremely pointed and flexible, Medesy explorers guarantee excellent tactile sensitivity during exploration. The range is wide and mounted on different handles: choose the one you prefer to further maximise performance!

name: Self-aspirating syringe
categoryPath: surgery > self aspirating syringes > syringes surgery
description: Self-aspirating syringe made of high quality stainless steel with peek inserts, one of the most popular on the market! It was recently reintroduced to the MEDESY range in a revised and further improved version that is even more functional and even more durable due to the careful selection of raw materials. Available with European or American tip. Compatible with 1.8-ml anaesthetic vials.

name: Plane mirror
categoryPath: mirrors and handles > diagnostics > dental mirrors
description: The dental mirror is the most typical instrument for the inspection of the oral cavity and soft tissues as well as the anterior and posterior teeth. It is also often used as protection in both conservative and surgical manoeuvres. Medesy offers various models in various sizes according to specific needs. Sold in packs of 12.

name: Endodontic instrument
categoryPath: endodontics > spreaders > restorative > pluggers and spreaders
description: Spreaders are the endodontic instruments with the sharpest and finest tips. The most common application methods are: “cold”, whose function is to laterally compact the master cone of gutta-percha against the root canal wall to make room for additional cones; “warm” whereby the root canal is heated by the previously heated tip. The Medesy line of spreaders is mounted on its Dalila stainless steel handles.

name: Amalgam carver
categoryPath: amalgam carver > amalgam instruments restorative > restorative
description: Amalgam is a material used for dental restorations that are still widespread on the market. Medesy offers a range of different complete carvers that are perfect for contouring and finishing fillings. The models proposed by Medesy include Ward, Hollenback, Nystrom, Wiland, Frahm… find out more about them.

name: Impression tray kit, other materials
categoryPath: kits and sets laboratory > impression tray kit > laboratory
description: In addition to the many stainless steel models, Medesy also offers a full and varied range of disposable plastic impression trays that are perfect for making custom changes depending on the patient’s anatomical needs. They are available in sets and also in polycarbonate versions specifically for edentulous and partially dentate patients.

name: Clamps tray
categoryPath: endodontics > rubber dam instruments > restorative
description: Clamps tray designed to simplify the daily workflow of dental professionals, ideal for organising various kinds of clamps and preventing them from falling from the operating table or getting lost.

name: Adjustable band seater
categoryPath: auxiliary instruments and accessories > instruments for band and ligatures > orthodontics
description: Adjustable stainless steel band seater, mounted on octagonal handle, practical and handy. Total size of the instrument 140 mm.

name: Intraligamental syringe
categoryPath: surgery > intraligamental syringes > syringes surgery
description: In contrast to traditional anaesthesia, which involves an entire area, intraligamental anaesthesia is less invasive and less bothersome. In fact, the anaesthetic is locally injected directly into the ligament of the tooth; this ensures rapid, deep, and total anaesthesia of an individual tooth. Where possible therefore, it is preferable to use the intraligamental method. MEDESY offers several models so that dentists can find the one that best suits their needs. Compatible with 1.8-ml anaesthetic vials.

name: Dental dam clamp
categoryPath: endodontics > rubber dam instruments > restorative
description: Attach the dental dam to the clamps to isolate the relevant teeth for treatment. Medesy has a complete and varied range of dental dam clamps, including specific models for each tooth. Thanks to premium steel and a special heat treatment, the new MEDESY dam clamps retain their elasticity over time. Anchor holes are universally compatible with the various shapes of clamp forceps and the edges are chamfered for more comfort.

name: Plastic single-use impression tray
categoryPath: single use impression tray > impression trays > laboratory
description: Medesy impression trays are perforated and available in various sizes. These disposable devices are particularly useful when it is necessary to make holes, cuts or changes for the right hold.

name: Caliper
categoryPath: calipers > calipers and mallets > implantology
description: Calipers are used to measure and evaluate different situations during the preparation phase of implant surgery. They are designed and developed for measuring the depth, length and space between the teeth. Medesy offers a varied range to meet different needs.

name: Gracey short type curette
categoryPath: gracey curettes > periodontics > curette and scaler
description: Every Gracey “short type” curette is designed to act on specific areas of the oral cavity. This line has the same features as the “long type” version; the difference between the two versions is visible in the end of the active tip which is shorter in this version, in order to facilitate procedures in deep and narrow periodontal pockets.

name: Laboratory modelling instrument
categoryPath: modelling and wax instruments > modelling instruments > laboratory
description: A line of stainless steel modelling instruments with special handle with improved grip. These double-ended instruments feature a combination of spatulas, blades and tips for modelling.

name: Medimpla mini root elevator
categoryPath: surgery > root elevators > elevators > extraction
description: We have completely overhauled our range of MEDIMPLA micro elevators; the design is more modern, and above all, more functional thanks to the flat parts which facilitate a firmer grip during elevation. Inserting the MEDIMPLA elevator into the intra-ligamental site will be even easier thanks to its even finer tips which are skilfully curved to facilitate its use. All of this ensures the most atraumatic extraction possible, so that the alveolar bone can be maintained in perfect condition. The special “pen” shape ensures particularly delicate movements.

name: Root elevator set
categoryPath: surgery > root elevators kits and sets > kits and sets > extraction
description: MEDESY is proud to be working in close collaboration with dental professionals and establishing communicative relationships of mutual esteem which help us to design and market increasingly cutting-edge instruments to satisfy the new demands of modern odontology. To assist professionals in their choice of models, MEDESY offers the option of pre-selecting dental extraction instruments in collaboration with these same esteemed dental professionals.

name: Set of tooth forceps
categoryPath: surgery > kits and sets > tooth forceps set > extraction
description: Thanks to the help of dental professionals who have always collaborated closely with MEDESY, the sets of forceps that we have assembled include the most requested and most popular models on the market. This is a great time-saver for the dentist who doesn’t have time to waste on deciding which forceps to buy; we’ve already taken care of it! If you need to change out some of the models in the selection or compose your own set from scratch, we are available to assist you! All our sets are offered in packaging made entirely of FSC®-certified paper, which is totally recyclable, a green choice of which we are very proud.

name: Set for dental prosthesis
categoryPath: kits and sets laboratory > dental prosthesis kit > laboratory
description: Medesy dental prosthesis set, available as a version for mobile prostheses and one for fixed prostheses. Designed with everything organised into practical zipped pouches ready for when it is needed.

name: Medesy syndesmotome 1651
categoryPath: surgery > syndesmotomes and periotomes > syndesmotomes > extraction
description: For all those professionals who prefer to have many models of syndesmotome available but without sacrificing practicality and with a minimum of bulk, MEDESY has assembled a kit complete with handle, set of 11 different tips, and a practical tip holder insert to have them ready for use and easily identifiable at all times during the procedure, all contained in one of our GAMMAFIX sterilisation trays! Order, practicality and effectiveness guaranteed!

name: Tongue forceps
categoryPath: surgery > suture tweezers tongue forceps and gauzes > forceps and tweezers
description: Scissor-handle tongue forceps with rack-and-pinion locking system for better control during use and a more secure grip. Various models available depending on the needs of the practitioner.

name: Excavator kit
categoryPath: excavators kits > restorative > kits and sets restorative
description: Kit with 5 models in Medesy’s 570 line of excavators, enclosed in one of our extraordinary GAMMAFIX sterilisation trays.

name: Bone curette kit
categoryPath: bone curette kit > surgery > kit e set surgery
description: Want to purchase the entire line of Lucas or Hemingway bone curettes? Medesy has assembled kits, packaged in sterilisation trays with silicone inserts, so you can have all models on hand at all times. Available in 6 mm solid handle ø or 8 mm hollow ø handle versions.

name: Dental dam kit
categoryPath: endodontics > rubber dam kit > restorative > kits and sets endodontics
description: Dental dams are used ever more frequently in dental practices. Clinics are providing more safety measures to protect patients and staff from bacteriological contamination. Dental dams are also an excellent way for professionals to isolate the area they are treating. Our kit is perfect for assembling dams using various installation techniques. Also available in BLACK version.

name: Amalgam kit
categoryPath: amalgam instruments > restorative > kits and sets restorative
description: Everything needed to contour the amalgam during restoration all in two kits specifically designed and combined for rigorous professionals. Two options available: a basic kit (REF 1675/1) with all the essentials, and an advanced kit (REF 1675/2) for more complex cases.

name: Composite kit
categoryPath: composite kits > restorative > kits and sets restorative
description: Three kits provided with a selection of items for restorative dental procedures. Two of the kits contain all the essentials for posterior (REF 1675/3) and anterior composites (REF 1675/4) respectively. The third is for more advanced treatments (REF 1675/5). The composite instruments are coated in TiN, ensuring they do not adhere as the material is being contoured and for ease of cleaning.

name: Endodontic kit
categoryPath: endodontics > endodontic kits > restorative > kits and sets endodontics
description: Kit with everything an endodontist needs, including a selection of pluggers, endodontic explorers, forceps and more.

name: Stainless steel impression tray kit
categoryPath: kits and sets laboratory > impression tray kit > laboratory
description: Full kits with all impression tray sizes, available for each line. The impression trays are contained within an elegant, fully recyclable box made from FSC-certified card. A green choice that Medesy is pleased to offer its customers.

name: Plugger or spreader kit
categoryPath: endodontics > pluggers and spreaders kit > restorative > kits and sets endodontics
description: MEDESY offers PLUGGER and SPREADER KITS with 5 models of pluggers (REF 542/KIT) or spreaders (REF 543/KIT) in different sizes.

name: Sinus lift instrument kit
categoryPath: kits and sets implantology > implantology

The kits are packaged in a sterilisation tray with a silicone closure to keep the instruments and organised and in place.

name: Bone and the maxillary sinus treatment kit
categoryPath: kits and sets implantology > implantology
description: Discover the kits we have designed for implantologists in collaboration with industry professionals. Complete kits for the flawless performance of various implant surgery procedures, bone treatment and maxillary sinus elevation.

name: Kit ortho advanced
categoryPath: kits and sets orthodontics > orthodontics
description: Four kits that perfectly summarize the best selection of tools for performing different orthodontic procedures. Together with professionals in the sector who collaborate with us, we have created a basic kit, ORTHO CLASSIC, one for more complex procedures, ORTO ADVANCED, and two more specific kits for bands and brackets. Scrollo down and discover them!

name: Periodontal surgery kit
categoryPath: kits and sets periodontics > periodontics > periodontal kit
description: The instruments included in Medesy’s periodontal surgery kits are carefully selected in close collaboration with industry professionals who advise us and help us constantly improve.

name: Perimplantite kit
categoryPath: kits and sets periodontics > periodontal kit with titanium instruments > periodontics
description: The bacterial aggression observed on the neck portion of implants is similar to that present at the level of the mucogingival junction of the tooth. However, steel instruments may contaminate the titanium implants, while plastic instruments do not perform adequate cleaning. The best solution for efficient, safe management of the problem is to use titanium instruments.

name: Gracey curette kit
categoryPath: kits and sets periodontics > gracey curettes kits > periodontics
description: Our Gracey curette kits assemble all the models of each complete series, so you always have all the models of the range available and can intervene in every area of the oral cavity. Choose the kit with the model and handle you prefer!

categoryPath: surgery kit > surgery > kit e set surgery
description: A pre-selection of everything needed to effectively treat soft tissue. All the essentials at your fingertips during surgery: tweezers, needle holder, scalpels, scissors and periosteal elevator. Like all our kits, our 1672/2 soft-tissue surgery kit is packaged in one of our convenient and practical GAMMAFIX by MEDESY sterilisation trays.

name: Soft tissues microsurgical kit
categoryPath: surgery > kits and sets micro surgery > micro surgery
description: Our soft tissue microsurgical kit, 1954/KIT, has been specifically designed for the perfect management of soft tissues during microsurgical procedures. In one of our exclusive GAMMAFIX by MEDESY trays, you will find a selection of instruments including high-quality microsurgical tissue tweezers, needle holders with tungsten carbide inserts, an endosteal elevator, a microsurgical scalpel and a pack of 25 sterile microblades.

name: Basic kit for microsurgery
categoryPath: surgery > kits and sets micro surgery > micro surgery
description: MEDESY’s 1956/KIT basic microsurgery kit is a selection of some of the best performing instruments from among our top sellers! Everything you need for performing a microsurgical procedure with precision and efficiency. Among the instruments that are included in one of our GAMMAFIX trays is one of our exclusive SUPERIOR CUT scissors and the diamond Castroviejo needle holder.

name: Periodontal kit
categoryPath: kits and sets periodontics > periodontics > periodontal kit
description: Our kits for periodontology now include a new entry: Kit 1671/8, a basic periodontology kit that contains a selection of renovated and even more high-performance instruments. Check out the other periodontal kits available below.

name: Osteotome kit
categoryPath: kits and sets implantology > implantology
description: To make sure you always have all the osteotome sizes at hand to tackle any type of implant site preparation, we thought we would also offer them in complete kits with all the models. Neatly arranged inside one of our Gammafix sterilisation trays, organisation, practicality and efficiency guaranteed.

name: First visit kit
categoryPath: diagnostics > kits and sets diagnostics
description: Our diagnostics kit, also known as the first visit kit, comprises everything needed for a flawless initial assessment of the state of the patient’s health: truly a must-have that no dental practice can do without.

name: Periodontal microsurgery kit
categoryPath: kits and sets periodontics > periodontal kit with titanium instruments > periodontics
description: One of the most prestigious products in the entire Medesy range is our kit 1671/7 which contains a selection of very light, biocompatible pure titanium instruments which guarantee excellent performance, particularly during microsurgery and periodontal microsurgery.

categoryPath: surgery kit > surgery > kit e set surgery

name: Basic surgery kit
categoryPath: surgery kit > surgery > kit e set surgery
description: All the instruments that a dental surgeon cannot do without! A selection of our best-sellers to make up an essential kit: tweezers, needle holder, superior cut scissors, and much more! All neatly contained in one of our outstanding GAMMAFIX by Medesy sterilisation trays.

name: Microsurgical kit
categoryPath: surgery > kits and sets micro surgery > micro surgery
description: A complete kit with a selection of high-quality instruments that can ensure that the dental surgeon will have the essentials to hand during the complex phases of a microsurgical procedure. Like all our kits, our REF 1950/KIT microsurgery kit is packaged in one of our exclusive GAMMAFIX by MEDESY sterilisation trays.

name: Apicectomy kit
categoryPath: endodontics > endodontic kits > restorative > kits and sets endodontics
description: Full kit for apicectomies, perfect for treating infections of canal roots with retrograde endodontic surgery, without using more radical treatment.

name: Luniascheck tonsil gauze packers
categoryPath: various accessories > accessories
description: Our LUNIATSCHEK gauze packer has also been refreshed and improved, now enriched by our DALILA unique handle that ensures an easier grip and facilitates the washing and sterilization procedures thanks to our Dalila clean and nice design.

name: Sharpening stones
categoryPath: sharpening stones > periodontics > accesories for periodontal instruments
description: The new Medesy sharpening stones are the ideal tool for repeated sharpening of curettes, ensuring precision and ease of use. Available in two variants: Arkansas and India . Arkansas stones , among the rarest and most valuable natural sharpening stones, are distinguished by their exceptional hardness and compactness. They allow you to sharpen while simultaneously polishing, ensuring an extremely fine razor edge. Indian stones , on the other hand, are manufactured from aluminium oxide, whose friable abrasive grains reduce metal removal during the sharpening process, thus prolonging the lifespan of the blade.

name: Implant probe
categoryPath: calipers > calipers and mallets > implantology
description: The implant probe is a diagnostic instrument designed for monitoring dental implants. It allows clinicians to assess the depth of the peri-implant sulcus and evaluate the condition of the surrounding soft tissues, supporting accurate diagnosis and atraumatic examinations during follow-up appointments. Our range includes both a fully stainless steel model and a special version with titanium tips, designed to meet different clinical needs.

name: Plugger, other models
categoryPath: modelling instruments and pluggers > composite and modelling instruments > restorative
description: Ladmore, White, Westcott, Three angle… these are some of the models of Medesy’s pluggers for restorative dentistry. Double-ended instruments with different combinations of tip shape and size for optimal performance of filling procedures and tooth reconstruction techniques.

name: Scaler American Pattern
categoryPath: periodontics > scaler curette and scaler > curette and scaler
description: American Pattern scalers are designed for the effective removal of supragingival calculus, particularly in interproximal areas. The sickle-shaped working end and the shank angulation provide optimal access to anterior teeth and premolar surfaces, ensuring precision and efficiency during scaling. Discover the two available models.

name: Endodontic instrument cleaner
categoryPath: endodontics > endodontic boxes and accessories > endodontic accessories > restorative
description: Cleaner for aluminium endodontic instruments, provided with screw cap and sponge. Replacement sponges sold separately in packs of 50.
